claims: The 130th Boston Marathon is scheduled for Monday, April 20, 2026.
The 130th Boston Marathon is on Patriots' Day.
The 130th Boston Marathon is managed by the Boston Athletic Association (B.A.A.).
The 130th Boston Marathon has a cut-off time of 4 minutes and 34 seconds (4:34).
The cut-off time of 4:34 was applied to the 24,362 accepted qualifiers.
The 130th Boston Marathon starts with wheelchair divisions at 9:02 a.m.
The 130th Boston Marathon features a rolling start beginning at 10:00 a.m.
24,362 runners were accepted from 33,249 applicants for the 2026 Boston Marathon.
Applicants for the 2026 Boston Marathon had to run 4:34 faster than their age-standard qualifying time.
Men's Wheelchair division starts at 9:02 a.m. ET for the 2026 Boston Marathon.
Women's Wheelchair division starts at 9:05 a.m. ET for the 2026 Boston Marathon.
Professional Men start at 9:37 a.m. ET for the 2026 Boston Marathon.
Professional Women start at 9:45 a.m. ET for the 2026 Boston Marathon.
Rolling Start begins at 10:00 a.m. ET for the 2026 Boston Marathon.
The 2026 Boston Marathon course is the traditional 26.2-mile course from Hopkinton to Boston's Copley Square.
The 2026 Boston Marathon is presented by Bank of America.
Road closures for the 2026 Boston Marathon begin as early as 8:00 a.m. along the entire length of the course.
Road closures for the 2026 Boston Marathon particularly impact Beacon Street.
Qualification standards are listed on the B.A.A. official website.
